class.name: Summator
class.brief_description: Minimal counter class used as a custom C++ module example.
class.description: [Summator] keeps a running integer total. It exists only to demonstrate how a custom engine module (built with [code]scons custom_modules=...[/code]) registers a class in [ClassDB] and documents it. [codeblock] var s = Summator.new() s.add(5) s.add(7) print(s.get_total()) # 12 [/codeblock]

method.name: add
method.description: Adds [param value] to the running total.

method.name: reset
method.description: Sets the running total back to [code]0[/code].
